description: SOURCE CONFLICT ON IDENTITY - Aerial Visuals dossier 3233 gives US Navy T-33B BuNo 141538 c/n 580-9594 with civil registration N13007; the silverhawkauthor compilation gives USAF T-33A 55-3053 with the SAME c/n 580-9594; the shared c/n means one identity is a mis-transcription; 141538 sits correctly in the T-33B BuNo range 141501 to 141549 and the N-number gives an FAA registry check so it is preferred here; mounted on a pylon; present in the current 2026 OpenStreetMap extract as node 10220883562 on Airport Road
